system.description: Beginning at 17th level, your passion and drive is so potent that you have weaponized this passion into a flurry of strikes that cripple foes and help build your legend, expanding your techniques alure. When you cast a Taijutsu that has the Finisher keyword, you may spend 3 Martial die. When you do, you may gain the benefits of your Tempo Boost martial technique while still applying the jutsu’s Finisher effects.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
